children: In Australia, the healthcare and insurance sectors appear the best places for investors to hide if they are worried about the unwinding of the AI trade, says UBS. It highlights "consistent negative share price correlations" to both the PHLX (Philly) Semiconductor index and the Global DC index. UBS has overweight recommendations on both the healthcare and insurance sectors. Strategist Richard Schellbach views them "as not just detached from the AI cycle, but also providing portfolio defence against the headwinds currently coming from the housing and interest rate challenges the domestic economy is facing." (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
